name: Ferrofluid Spikes
desc: A pool of oil-black ferrofluid bristling into the iconic hexagonal Rosensweig spike array under a pulsing magnetic field, its sharp 3D peaks rising, migrating and merging while each catches an iridescent petrol-and-gold rim and a white-hot specular tip.

field.doc: magnetic field strength - spike height & sharpness (higher = taller, sharper, more-merged bristles)

density.doc: how many spike charge-centers are active (higher = denser array)

scale.doc: spike spacing / size (higher = fewer, bigger spikes)

x.doc: magnet focus x - spikes rise taller nearest this point

y.doc: magnet focus y - spikes rise taller nearest this point

alpha.doc: opacity for VJ compositing (100 = opaque bg)
